role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero gate for a deterministic global physical coarse-space residual correction appended to the sealed v258 endpoint. It is not a rerun of the closed v256 coarse-K4/fine-K10 solve, a detector partition, a coefficient search, training, a resource test, an external gate or real BOST.
scientific_question: Can one exact residual correction constrained to the fixed 16x8x8 physical Galerkin space recover K16-matched field, gradient, interior-gradient and observation accuracy on all thirteen opened Case 19 rigs with the same 16A+15A^T ledger as the sealed v267 full-row and two-color controls?
physical_hypothesis: The v267 failure was caused by destructive synchronization of detector-local directions. A single globally coupled low-frequency physical direction may reduce the full observation residual while preserving the v258 field advantage because its coarse basis couples all cameras through the exact adjoint before line search.
design_evidence_boundary: Only already opened, independently sealed v256, v265.1 and v267 evidence may motivate this post-open diagnostic. No v268 Case 19 coarse normal, direction, coefficient, candidate field, residual, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this protocol, core, runner, validator and synthetic tests are committed. Synthetic tests must not read Case 19.

No array was saved, no prediction marker was created, no truth or metric was read, and the failed run is permanently non-scientific. v268.1 changed only the single-frame permutation audit adapter.

No numeric metric or scientific result was viewed. v268.2 changed only that truth-audit field contract. The failed run is permanently non-scientific and none of its partial artifacts, including metrics.npy, may be read or reused.
execution_history.v268_2: An initial launch failed before the bound-commit check because the invocation supplied an incorrect expected commit and wrote no scientific array. The corrected immutable execution then sealed all thirteen predictions, read the already opened truth and saved metrics, but exited before formal_report or READY because the full-sequence loader nests the already validated scalar audit under truth_stack_audit. Both failed roots are permanently non-scientific and none of their partial artifacts, including metrics.npy, may be read or reused.
execution_history.v268_3: The immutable formal execution completed with all validity checks true and remained pending independent validation; no scientific summary was viewed. The unique independent execution then sealed all thirteen independent predictions but failed before reading truth, formal arrays or metrics because it imported the formal v244 module while calling the independent truth loader. v268.4 changes only that validator import to the already sealed independent v244 implementation; every scientific choice, candidate, control, gate and cost remains unchanged. The v268.3 formal and validation roots remain permanently inconclusive and may not be reused.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: Reuse the exact canonical nine-camera roster and ordering sealed by v265.1 for every rig.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth is forbidden until the v268 candidate and all deployment-visible states are sealed. It is then read only to score four veto metrics.

unique_primary.name: coarse_residual_galerkin_steepest_descent
unique_primary.parent: Use the corresponding formal or independent recreated-v258 field and exact deployment-visible residual from the sealed v265.1 tree. The inherited ledger is 15A+14A^T.
unique_primary.transfer: Use only the frozen v256 cell-centred separable piecewise-linear tensor transfer from 16x8x8 to 32x16x16, followed by the frozen one-voxel support and active-mean gauge projection. Restriction is the exact Euclidean adjoint of that lift.
unique_primary.coarse_direction: Compute fine normal n=A^T r, coarse normal g=P^T n, and physical direction d=P g. This is one globally coupled physical low-frequency direction; no geometry-Jacobi inverse, detector partition, truth, time, rig label or metric enters it.
unique_primary.coefficient: Compute q=A d and the unique unbounded full-residual least-squares coefficient alpha=<q,r>/<q,q>. If ||g||^2 and ||q||^2 are both at most 1e-30, deterministically set alpha=0 and return the parent; any inconsistent degenerate state is invalid. Otherwise numerator and denominator must exceed 1e-30 and alpha must be positive.
unique_primary.candidate: x_candidate=x_v258+alpha*d and r_candidate=r-alpha*q. A separate full physical replay is offline scoring and excluded from the deployment ledger.

accuracy_gate.two_replica_envelope: For candidate and controls use the componentwise maximum of formal and independent metrics. For K16 use the componentwise minimum. Every cell must pass both absolute and matched gates.
accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If any equal-or-cheaper sealed control passes all thirteen envelope cells, the coarse-space advantage is not isolated.

forbidden_search: No coarse shape, interpolation, support, gauge, restriction, extra coarse direction, exact coarse solve, ridge, preconditioner, coefficient multiplier, clipping, damping, line-search alternative, parent, depth, endpoint blend, threshold, fallback, frame subset or rig subset may change after freeze. Do not rescue with a selector, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.

independent_validation.formal_implementation: The frozen v256 TensorTransfer plus the exact NumPy forward/adjoint operator.
independent_validation.independent_implementation: A separate program must construct all three interpolation matrices explicitly, apply tensor lift/restriction with independent einsum expressions, and recompute the candidate from the independently sealed v265.1 parent. It must not import the v268 core or runner.
independent_validation.replica_rule: Formal uses only the formal v265.1 parent and formal v267 controls. Independent uses only their separately sealed independent arrays. The independent program seals its candidate before reading formal v268 arrays or truth.

decision_order: Any protocol, source, parent, prediction-tree, shape, finite, transfer-adjoint, coarse-normal, least-squares, physical-replay, camera-permutation, call-ledger, independent-state or scoring closure failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_COARSE_RESIDUAL_GALERKIN_FRAME_ZERO_V268_4.

If the unique primary fails any of the thirteen absolute or K16-matched conservative-envelope cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_COARSE_RESIDUAL_GALERKIN_FRAME_ZERO_V268_4 and close this exact one-step physical coarse-space correction.
If the primary passes all thirteen but any equal-or-cheaper sealed control also passes all thirteen, conclude PASS_CASE19_COARSE_RESIDUAL_GALERKIN_BUT_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V268_4.

Only if the primary passes 13/13, every equal-or-cheaper sealed control remains incomplete, and independent validation passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_COARSE_RESIDUAL_GALERKIN_HEADROOM_V268_4. This authorizes only one separately frozen full-sequence gate.
failure_action: Close the fixed one-step 16x8x8 coarse residual correction without changing the basis, transfer, support, gauge, coefficient, parent, depth, controls or thresholds. Do not train or rent a GPU to rescue it.
